property_summary: For every call to transfer(...) with a non-empty _tos array, the reference contract never reverts (call returns true); the mutant that changes require(_tos.length > 1) will revert for any input where _tos.length == 1, so there exists fuzzed inputs (arrays of length 1) that make the mutant fail while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Change the require to require(_tos.length > 1) so calls with exactly one recipient that previously passed now revert (and vice versa).
